programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Tha na planntraisean 's na lusan aig Mamaidh ri cleòcadh san teas ach, gu fortanach, tha deagh bheachd aig Meanbh airson Mamaidh a chuideachadh len uisgeachadh. Mother’s plants and flowers are wilting in the heat but fortunately, Tiny has a brilliant idea to help Mother out with watering.

programme.title: Losgannan | Froglets
programme.desc: Tha na Losgannan a’ gabhail turas dàna spùinneadaireach a shireadh ulaidhean. The Froglets explore Lilly's desk and then set sail on a daring pirate quest for treasure.

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha Oona air bhioran! Tha i air cluinntinn g' eil gealach fìor shònraichte gu bhith ann a-nochd - sàr-ghealach. Ag ràdh ris a h-uile duine gum feum iad fuireach air an cois son a faicinn, an tig aice fhèin air fuireach na dùisg air a shon? Oona is a very excited puffin! She has heard that there is to be a very special moon tonight - a super-moon. Telling everyone that they must stay up to see it, will she be able to stay awake herself?

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha Baba a' lorg slige dheàrrsach a tha e airson a thoirt dhachaigh. Ge-tà, 's ann a tha rudan deàrrsach cuideachad a còrdadh ri faoileagan a tha airson an t-slige fhaighinn dhaibh p-fhèin! An tèid aig Oona 's Baba air teicheadh dhachaigh bhuapa? Baba finds a shiny shell that he wants to keep and take home with him. However, the seagulls also love shiny objects and want the shell for themselves! Will Oona and Baba be able to escape them and get home safely?

programme.title: Peicein/Petit
programme.desc: Tha Peicein a’ smaoineachadh dè cho àrd is a dh’fhàsadh craobhan mura deigheadh an leigeil? ‘S dòcha gun ruigeadh iad fànas! Tha e fhèin is a charaidean a’ cur plana air dòigh airson siubhal gu fànas, le bhith a’ sreap craobh. Ach chan fhada gus a bheil iad air turas eile gu ruige meadhan na talmhainn! Petit wonders how tall trees could grow if they never got cut down. Maybe they could grow into space! He and his friends plan a space journey on top of a tree, that will turn into a voyage to the centre of the Earth.

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: Tha na h-Abadas a' gabhail tòrr spòrs a' rolaigeadh sios cnoc. Ach tha geam sgoinneil eile aig Ben dhaibh: an geama fhaclan. Tha e a' toirt facal ùr iongantach dhaibh! Dè th'ann am 'boomerang' agus càit a bhiodh an t-àite as fheàrr airson fear a thilgeil? Thig is cluich le na h-Abadas fhad's a tha iad ga rannsachadh! We join the Abadas having an 'aba-doo-be-dee' time rolling down a hill. Ben has another great game for them to play: the word game. He introduces them to an exciting new word! What's a 'boomerang' and where would be the best place to throw one? Come and join the Abadas as they investigate!

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachd do chlann òga. Tha Abigail NicÌomhair a’ leughadh Blas na Dachaigh. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh le Maryam Hassan, a dhealbhachadh le Anna Wilson agus chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Dòmhnall Iain MacLeòid. Abigail Maciver reads Blas na Dachaigh by Maryam Hassan, illustrated by Anna Wilson and translated into Gaelic by Donald John MacLeod.

programme.title: An Teaghlach Rìoghail an Ath-dhoras/The Royals Next Door
programme.desc: Feumaidh Stella mathanas iarraidh air Mia agus Freya, an dèidh dhi breug innse dhaibh, ach saoil am bi a caraidean tuigseach? Stella must ask for forgiveness from Mia and Freya, after she’s told them a lie, but will her friends be understanding?

programme.title: An Teaghlach Rìoghail an Ath-dhoras/The Royals Next Door
programme.desc: Tha Stella airson ‘s gum bi oidhche gheamaichean aig an teaghlach Rìoghail ach saoil ciamar a dh’obraicheas sin a-mach? Stella wants to organise a Royal family games night, but how will that work out?

programme.title: Clann Na Cruinne
programme.desc: Anns a’ phrògram ghoirid seo tha balach òg a’ leantainn a mhiann a bhith a’ faicinn ochd-chasach dha fhèin. Lean Aonghas agus a chuid dealas airson ionnsachadh, agus e an tòir creutairean mara de ghach seòrsa, beag is mòr, annasach is anabarrach. A luminous and poetic short documentary following Aonghas, a young boy who roams the seashore in search of sea creatures, great and small, weird and wonderful. But will his dream of discovering an octopus ever come true?

programme.title: Belle and Sebastian
programme.desc: Chan eil beathaichean ceadaicht’ san fharpais teaghlaich, ’s chan eil Sebastian toilichte oir ‘s e Belle a theaghlach. Feumar rèiseadh le Angelina, an àite Belle. Ach dè an rùn-dìomhair a th’ aig Angelina? Animals aren’t allowed to participate in the family contest and Sebastian isn’t happy, as Belle is his family. He has to race with Angelina, instead of Belle. But what is Angelina’s secret?

programme.title: Seonaidh | Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Tha Seonaidh a' miannachadh beatha nas inntinniche. Nuair a tha Shirley dha dhèanamh comasach gur dòcha gun tachair sin, tha e air a dhòigh. Ach am bi an Treud nan cnap-starra? Shaun dreams of a life in the fast lane. When Shirley lands upon something that could make his wish come true, he can't believe his luck. The only obstacle that stands in his way is the rest of the flock.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Brunch le Abigail
programme.desc: Tha Abigail a’ dèanamh Overnight Oats le Sùbhagan is Piostaisean, math airson deagh bhracaist aig an taigh no airson a thoirt leat dhan oifis. Abigail makes raspberry and pistachio overnight oats, ideal for a breakfast snack, or to take with you to the office. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Machair
programme.desc: Drama Gàidhlig stèidhichte ann an Leòdhas. Gaelic soap based on the Isle of Lewis.

programme.title: Mach à Seo!
programme.desc: Ramsay takes an action-packed trip to Edinburgh. Gu leòr aig Ramsay ri dhèanamh ann an Dùn Èideann.

programme.title: An Clo Mor
programme.desc: Sìleas tries to make sense of everything as her world comes crashing down around her. Meanwhile, there’s tension in air between Seumas and Rory as neither men speak about what happened on the night of Seumas’s collapse. Tha Sìleas a’ feuchainn ri ciall a dhèanamh dhen a h-uile càil agus an saoghal aice a’ dol bun-os-cionn. Tha mì-rùn eadar Seumas agus Rory, gun duine seach duine aca a’ bruidhinn air na thachair an oidhche a leig Seumas roimhe. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Baile na h-Ola (Aberdeen: When Oil Came to Town)
programme.desc: Dhòirt an airgead a-steach, ach chan eil dìleab na h-ola ri fhaicinn ’s a bhaile an-diugh. Fifty years of oil has had a significant impact on Aberdeen, but what is the legacy?

programme.title: Belladrum
programme.desc: Tha Fiona NicChoinnich agus Niall Iain Dòmhnallach a’ cur fàilt’ air Toby Lee gu Àrd-Ùrlar Hot House aig Belladrum 2025. Ged nach eil Toby ach 20 bliadhna a dh’aois, tha na sàr-sgilean cluiche agus a ghuth iongantach air cothroman fhuasgladh dha air an àrd-ùrlar leis an luchd-ciùil as fheàrr – mar Buddy Guy, Billy Gibbons, Peter Frampton, Slash agus Joe Bonamassa. Fiona MacKenzie and Niall Iain Macdonald welcome Toby Lee to the Hot House Stage at Belladrum. A mind-blowing guitarist and a voice to match, the 20-year-old’s music belies his age and has seen him sharing the stage with the best in the business, including Buddy Guy, Billy Gibbons, Peter Frampton, Slash and Joe Bonamassa.

programme.title: Seirm
programme.desc: Màiri Anna NicUalraig le ceòl dùthchasach agus traidiseanta bho Celtic Connections. Mary Ann Kennedy presents a show with folk and traditional music from Celtic Connections.

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Horizon
programme.desc: In December 2015, Tim Peake became Britain’s first astronaut on board the International Space Station. For two years, he had been filming a video diary for Horizon as he prepared to leave. From family life to the rigorous training, this is an intimate portrait and remarkable insight into the world of an astronaut.

programme.title: Only Connect
programme.desc: Quiz show presented by Victoria Coren in which knowledge will only take you so far, as patience and lateral thinking are also vital. Three neuroscientists hailing from Australia, South Africa and Canada scrum down against the intellectual brawn of three rugby fans, as they compete to draw together the connections between many disparate elements that, at first glance, seem utterly bereft of associations. So what connects cream, quotation marks, tennis matches and yellow lines?

programme.desc: Legendary rock 'n' roller Chuck Berry performs at the BBC Television Theatre in 1972. Johnny B Goode, Roll Over Beethoven and Nadine are just some of the highlights of this concert, shown in an extended cut. This version includes, for the first time, an epic rendition of My Ding-a-Ling that carries all before it and raises innuendo to an art form.

programme.title: Doorbell Detectives
programme.desc: Matt Allwright meets the husband and wife doorbell detectives who used their doorbell video to follow the clue from a criminal’s tattoo and get the men who robbed their neighbour put behind bars. More footage shows how two masked men trapped a couple in their home just to steal the catalytic converter from a prized vehicle. And former police inspector Anton Sullivan shows the one simple way you can prevent your car being broken into.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Featuring a Kent house with not one, but two front doors. Will it be twice as much work or double the profit? Plus, two fascinating Welsh auction lots.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: In Devon, Christina Trevanion learns the incredible story of the World War II soldier who bravely played the bagpipes as bullets rained down on British commandos during the D-Day landings in Normandy. Bill Millin’s son John explains how his Scottish father was ordered to play his pipes as troops landed on Sword Beach on 6 June 1944 – and how fearless Bill unwittingly mooned German troops in the process! A battle of a very different kind is taking place in Exeter among the antiques stalls as two teams of friends go bargain-hunting with experts Ben Cooper and Gary Pe. Long-time pals Sue and Jane have animal collectibles on their shopping list, while mates Ben and Kieran are on a mission to make the biggest profit on the show ever. As the hour ticks down, the blue team make Gary laugh when they mistake a Victorian washing dolly for a toilet plunger. Over with the reds, Ben is lost for words when he spots a tantalus, and tension rises at the auction when the winning team is announced.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Alistair Appleton relishes being in his home county of West Sussex as he shows off some of its many delights including, of course, a selection of beautiful properties. He is with a married couple who want to follow in his footsteps by escaping London in search of a new life and home in the countryside.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Chris Hull and Frances Tophill are in Leicester to help Pritesh and Mita transform their run-down plot, which is cluttered with discarded furniture, uneven patio areas and struggling plants, into a garden inspired by India, with blooming marigolds and homegrown vegetables. Pritesh and Mita dream of a patio and pergola for meals and entertaining their extended family, a water feature and a cosy seating area. They are also hoping for raised beds to revive their vegetable patch and flowers, a cherished project for the space that used to be looked after by their late grandmother. With Mita’s health declining and daily life demanding their attention, the garden has fallen into disrepair. Now, they hope to restore it as a beautiful, vibrant space that honours their grandmother’s memory and brings the family together. Can the Garden Rescue team turn this neglected plot into a flourishing Indian-inspired garden on a £5,500 budget?

programme.title: The Travelling Auctioneers
programme.desc: Martin from Morecambe has always been obsessed with the world of entertainment. Well, his uncle was a lion tamer after all! So, after sharing the bill with greats like Ken Dodd and Danny La Rue, he was bitten by the performing bug and settled in the showbiz capital of Blackpool. An avid collector with a penchant for puppets, Martin’s home has gradually been taken over by a whole host of circus-style paraphernalia, and it’s time to evict some. Izzie Balmer and Robin Johnson are on hand to clear some space and raise some funds so that Martin can fulfil his dream of launching a puppet museum. Izzie has just one day to work her way through Martin’s eclectic bonkers collection, while Robin will be adding extra value restoring those items in need of a bit of TLC, from a ventriloquist puppet who has lost his strings to an out-of-key musical machine. There’s no denying today’s challenges are unique.

programme.title: Pointless
programme.desc: The brainy quiz returns - but this time host Alexander Armstrong is joined by co-host Lucy Porter. As always, contestants try to score as few points as possible by plumbing the depths of their general knowledge to come up with the answers no-one else could think of.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage as host nation USA face Australia at the Seattle Stadium in their second game in Group D. Coached by former Tottenham boss Mauricio Pochettino, the USA are making a twelfth appearance at the tournament, with their best result being a semi-final appearance back in the very first World Cup in 1930. Australia reached the last 16 in Qatar four years ago before being knocked out by the eventual winners Argentina. These two teams have never met before at the World Cup.

programme.desc: Chris Hull and Frances Tophill are in Leicester to help Pritesh and Mita transform their run-down plot, which is cluttered with discarded furniture, uneven patio areas and struggling plants, into a garden inspired by India, with blooming marigolds and homegrown vegetables. Can the Garden Rescue team turn this neglected plot into a flourishing Indian-inspired garden on a £5,500 budget?

There’s no denying today’s challenges are unique.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: In Devon, Christina Trevanion learns the incredible story of the World War II soldier who bravely played the bagpipes as bullets rained down on British commandos during the D-Day landings in Normandy. Bill Millin’s son John explains how his Scottish father was ordered to play his pipes as troops landed on Sword Beach on 6 June 1944 – and how fearless Bill unwittingly mooned German troops in the process! A battle of a very different kind is taking place in Exeter among the antiques stalls as two teams of friends go bargain-hunting with experts Ben Cooper and Gary Pe. Long-time pals Sue and Jane have animal collectibles on their shopping list, while mates Ben and Kieran are on a mission to make the biggest profit on the show ever. As the hour ticks down, the blue team make Gary laugh when they mistake a Victorian washing dolly for a toilet plunger. Over with the reds, Ben is lost for words when he spots a tantalus, and tension rises at the auction when the winning team is announced.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt

Bill Millin’s son John explains how his Scottish father was ordered to play his pipes as troops landed on Sword Beach on 6 June 1944 – and how fearless Bill unwittingly mooned German troops in the process! A battle of a very different kind is taking place in Exeter among the antiques stalls as two teams of friends go bargain-hunting with experts Ben Cooper and Gary Pe. As the hour ticks down, the blue team make Gary laugh when they mistake a Victorian washing dolly for a toilet plunger. Over with the reds, Ben is lost for words when he spots a tantalus, and tension rises at the auction when the winning team is announced.

programme.title: Doorbell Detectives
programme.desc: Matt Allwright meets the husband and wife doorbell detectives who used their doorbell video to follow the clue from a criminal’s tattoo and get the men who robbed their neighbour put behind bars. More footage shows how two masked men trapped a couple in their home just to steal the catalytic converter from a prized vehicle. And former police inspector Anton Sullivan shows the one simple way you can prevent your car being broken into.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Featuring a Kent house with not one, but two front doors. Will it be twice as much work or double the profit? Plus, two fascinating Welsh auction lots.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: In Devon, Christina Trevanion learns the incredible story of the World War II soldier who bravely played the bagpipes as bullets rained down on British commandos during the D-Day landings in Normandy. Bill Millin’s son John explains how his Scottish father was ordered to play his pipes as troops landed on Sword Beach on 6 June 1944 – and how fearless Bill unwittingly mooned German troops in the process! A battle of a very different kind is taking place in Exeter among the antiques stalls as two teams of friends go bargain-hunting with experts Ben Cooper and Gary Pe. Long-time pals Sue and Jane have animal collectibles on their shopping list, while mates Ben and Kieran are on a mission to make the biggest profit on the show ever. As the hour ticks down, the blue team make Gary laugh when they mistake a Victorian washing dolly for a toilet plunger. Over with the reds, Ben is lost for words when he spots a tantalus, and tension rises at the auction when the winning team is announced.

programme.title: BBC News at One
programme.desc: The latest national and international news from the BBC.

programme.title: Under the Vines
programme.desc: At a wine conference, Tippy is in the spotlight, Louis learns of Philippe’s past, and Daisy makes a drunken move.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Alistair Appleton relishes being in his home county of West Sussex as he shows off some of its many delights including, of course, a selection of beautiful properties. He is with a married couple who want to follow in his footsteps by escaping London in search of a new life and home in the countryside.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Chris Hull and Frances Tophill are in Leicester to help Pritesh and Mita transform their run-down plot, which is cluttered with discarded furniture, uneven patio areas and struggling plants, into a garden inspired by India, with blooming marigolds and homegrown vegetables. Pritesh and Mita dream of a patio and pergola for meals and entertaining their extended family, a water feature and a cosy seating area. They are also hoping for raised beds to revive their vegetable patch and flowers, a cherished project for the space that used to be looked after by their late grandmother. With Mita’s health declining and daily life demanding their attention, the garden has fallen into disrepair. Now, they hope to restore it as a beautiful, vibrant space that honours their grandmother’s memory and brings the family together. Can the Garden Rescue team turn this neglected plot into a flourishing Indian-inspired garden on a £5,500 budget?

programme.title: The Travelling Auctioneers
programme.desc: Martin from Morecambe has always been obsessed with the world of entertainment. Well, his uncle was a lion tamer after all! So, after sharing the bill with greats like Ken Dodd and Danny La Rue, he was bitten by the performing bug and settled in the showbiz capital of Blackpool. An avid collector with a penchant for puppets, Martin’s home has gradually been taken over by a whole host of circus-style paraphernalia, and it’s time to evict some. Izzie Balmer and Robin Johnson are on hand to clear some space and raise some funds so that Martin can fulfil his dream of launching a puppet museum. Izzie has just one day to work her way through Martin’s eclectic bonkers collection, while Robin will be adding extra value restoring those items in need of a bit of TLC, from a ventriloquist puppet who has lost his strings to an out-of-key musical machine. There’s no denying today’s challenges are unique.

programme.desc: Live coverage as host nation USA face Australia at the Seattle Stadium in their second game in Group D. Coached by former Tottenham boss Mauricio Pochettino, the USA are making a twelfth appearance at the tournament, with their best result being a semi-final appearance back in the very first World Cup in 1930. Australia reached the last 16 in Qatar four years ago before being knocked out by the eventual winners Argentina. These two teams have never met before at the World Cup.

programme.title: Stormborn
programme.desc: The animals of the north face worsening weather in autumn and the first stirrings of winter. Grey seals and reindeer turn their attention to mating, hormones run wild as males compete, and young animals venture away from their parents for the first time. In Iceland, the cliff Arctic fox family is thriving, but it’s a different story for the foxes denning at the shoreline. Only one of the cubs has survived. Now, abandoned by her parents, she must fend for herself. On the Monach Isles, 35,000 grey seals arrive for the annual breeding season. A pup faces danger on the beach, getting lost and swept up into a fight between two raging bulls. As winter arrives, the reindeer herd in Norway must migrate to their grazing grounds in the mountains, but this involves a perilous two-mile swim across open water.

programme.title: My Kind of Town
programme.desc: Ian Hamilton and his guide dog Major travel to Peterhead, where the North Sea meets hard graft. Built on fishing, and now the home of the biggest fish market in Europe, Peterhead reinvented itself with the arrival of oil and gas but is now looking towards renewables. Ian and Major complain about the early start as they visit the fish market, before Ian plays some crazy golf at a newly renovated town centre park. The pair then head to the harbour to find out about a big new investment in the town, and Ian takes a trip in a fish van around the local area. After a visit to the notorious Peterhead Prison, which is now a museum, Ian finds himself locked away by the crew, but he manages to escape for a peaceful sailing trip to finish his time in the town.

programme.title: Still Game
programme.desc: Scottish sitcom. Romance is in the air when Jack asks the woman in the charity shop out on a date, but Victor may end up as a gooseberry.

programme.title: Two Doors Down
programme.desc: As the episode opens, Michelle and Alan are making the last minute tidy-ups before the neighbours arrive for the housewarming of their freshly decorated home. Beth and Eric are first in the door, followed by Christine wearing an eye patch (from a rogue newspaper eye-scratching incident), with Colin and Cathy not far behind. Cathy is of course not backward in coming forward with less than complimentary comments about the couple’s new-look home. Then in comes Louise, Michelle’s long-term friend, who has unexpectedly come by to drop off a housewarming gift. As Louise is deaf, she and Michelle talk in sign language, further frustrating Cathy’s determination to be the centre of attention.

programme.title: Things You Should Have Done
programme.desc: Stay-at-home-daughter Chi is suddenly forced to fend for herself when her parents die in a car crash. Chi learns she will only inherit the house on condition she completes a list of 'Things You Should Have Done' left in the parents' will, the first of which is, ironically, learn to drive. Meanwhile, Chi's highly strung auntie Karen wants nothing to do with her dependent pest of a niece, but very much wants the house she feels is rightfully hers. Chi ventures out into Ramsgate in search of a driving license and infiltrates the family of a mild-mannered driving instructor in the process.

programme.desc: Steve Backshall goes searching for Patagonia’s perfect predator: the puma. After waiting his whole life to see one, Steve sees a tiny cub and witnesses a female puma hunting an armadillo.

programme.title: Shrek Forever After
programme.desc: Rumpelstiltskin fools Shrek, who is suffering from a midlife crisis, into being erased from existence and placed in a sinister alternative reality ruled by Rumpel. Can Shrek restore his old life? The solution is just a kiss away... Animated comedy fantasy adventure.

programme.title: Funboys
programme.desc: The gang belatedly get involved in the Great Famine, the one thing they didn’t need to get involved in. Callum’s new job at the Ballymac Folk Museum sends him down a spiral of method acting as a starving peasant. And he’s helped along in this grovelling subservience by his new boss, tyrannical land steward Phillip. The sudden news, to Jordan, that a million people died during the potato famine causes him to finally develop empathy, and it turns out to be a real pain.

programme.title: Funboys
programme.desc: Strange things are afoot in Ballymacnoose: animals in small clothing, paranormal sightings of leprechauns, and most bizarrely of all, Callum gets his first ever match on a dating app. The one prickle on the pickle is that Gwen, Callum’s dream girl, is also in an open relationship with the 50-year-old Grainne, a woman who disembowels chickens for a living. Meanwhile, Gemma becomes obsessed with dressing farm animals in tiny clothing and causes Sammy to spin out in paranoia thinking that his farm has become infested with leprechauns. So Lorcan has no other choice but to introduce Gemma to the dark secrets of the Ballymacnoose Paranormal Society, also run by his da and Frank.

programme.title: Funboys
programme.desc: Life in Ballymacnoose becomes very complicated when Callum accidentally walks in on Gemma and Lorcan trying out a new form of lovemaking. The sight triggers a long-buried childhood trauma in Callum and raises uncomfortable questions about the town’s deeply repressed relationship with sex. Can Ballymacnoose open its heart to true love? Meanwhile, Jordan has officially begun dating his much older lover, 50-year-old Grainne. But as their relationship deepens, Jordan is confronted with another harsh reality of adulthood: he’s going bald. Faced with the slow retreat of his hairline and the love of a good woman, Jordan must decide whether to cling to denial or embrace manhood in all its forms - love, responsibility and mushroom carbonaras.

programme.title: Funboys
programme.desc: As Callum begins slowly unravelling under the strain of Jordan's relentless night terrors about baldness, he stumbles upon a flyer for Ballymacbot Wars - a local robot combat tournament offering a generous cash prize and potential ticket out of Jordan’s bedroom. Meanwhile, Jordan is uncharacteristically uninterested in the whole affair. He's become a bald hermit, terrified to leave the house and expose his creamy scalp to the outside world. That is, until, like a dagger in the night, a hooded burst of inspiration sends him back out into the world… and the robot wars.

programme.title: The Young Offenders
programme.desc: Friendship, loyalty, laughter and lots of mischief bring best pals Conor MacSweeney and Jock O’Keeffe into ongoing conflict with their school headmaster, Principal Barry Walsh. Getting caught up in the chaos is Conor's long suffering mother Mairead, something that happens very often as she tries to pick up the pieces after the lads' misbehaviour causes problems. A not-so-clever plan to earn some extra cash backfires, bringing the lads head to head with Sergeant Healy, who has been hot on their heels for some time and is determined to catch them up to no good.

programme.title: The Young Offenders
programme.desc: Comedy following the coming-of-age adventures of two best friends. Conor and Jock's friendships with the principal's daughters intensify, leading to a comic showdown.

programme.title: The Young Offenders
programme.desc: The lads persuade the girls to spend a full day with them on a beautiful adventure.

programme.title: The Young Offenders
programme.desc: Conor and his mam Mairead’s much loved fridge, bought by Conor’s dad, has finally given up on them. Remembering when the fridge was originally bought in town miles away, Mairead decides that a family bonding session on a road trip to that same town to buy a replacement fridge will be just the thing to bond with her son.

programme.title: The Young Offenders
programme.desc: Conor and Jock have been instructed to take up unpaid part-time work experience at Mairead's side on the fish stall in the English Market, bringing them up close and personal with life in the real world. With Jock's extra mouth to feed in the McSweeney household, money is getting more and more tight, leaving the trio to come up with inventive and unsatisfying ways of making food last longer. Determined to help out Mairead financially, the lads start to think about ways they can come up with some extra cash. The freak local catch of a very expensive fish gives the two lads an idea, leading them on a dubious adventure involving breaking and entering, a hilarious struggle and a memorable trip through Cork with their ill-gotten gains. Meanwhile, Mairead and Sergeant Healy are in two minds about taking their friendship to the next level, while Mairead tries to give Healy some driving lessons.

The sudden news, to Jordan, that a million people died during the potato famine causes him to finally develop empathy, and it turns out to be a real pain.

programme.title: Funboys
programme.desc: Strange things are afoot in Ballymacnoose: animals in small clothing, paranormal sightings of leprechauns, and most bizarrely of all, Callum gets his first ever match on a dating app. The one prickle on the pickle is that Gwen, Callum’s dream girl, is also in an open relationship with the 50-year-old Grainne, a woman who disembowels chickens for a living. Meanwhile, Gemma becomes obsessed with dressing farm animals in tiny clothing and causes Sammy to spin out in paranoia thinking that his farm has become infested with leprechauns. So Lorcan has no other choice but to introduce Gemma to the dark secrets of the Ballymacnoose Paranormal Society, also run by his da and Frank.

programme.title: Funboys
programme.desc: Life in Ballymacnoose becomes very complicated when Callum accidentally walks in on Gemma and Lorcan trying out a new form of lovemaking. The sight triggers a long-buried childhood trauma in Callum and raises uncomfortable questions about the town’s deeply repressed relationship with sex. Can Ballymacnoose open its heart to true love? Meanwhile, Jordan has officially begun dating his much older lover, 50-year-old Grainne. But as their relationship deepens, Jordan is confronted with another harsh reality of adulthood: he’s going bald. Faced with the slow retreat of his hairline and the love of a good woman, Jordan must decide whether to cling to denial or embrace manhood in all its forms - love, responsibility and mushroom carbonaras.

programme.title: Funboys
programme.desc: As Callum begins slowly unravelling under the strain of Jordan's relentless night terrors about baldness, he stumbles upon a flyer for Ballymacbot Wars - a local robot combat tournament offering a generous cash prize and potential ticket out of Jordan’s bedroom. Meanwhile, Jordan is uncharacteristically uninterested in the whole affair. He's become a bald hermit, terrified to leave the house and expose his creamy scalp to the outside world. That is, until, like a dagger in the night, a hooded burst of inspiration sends him back out into the world… and the robot wars.

programme.title: The Young Offenders
programme.desc: Friendship, loyalty, laughter and lots of mischief bring best pals Conor MacSweeney and Jock O’Keeffe into ongoing conflict with their school headmaster, Principal Barry Walsh. Getting caught up in the chaos is Conor's long suffering mother Mairead, something that happens very often as she tries to pick up the pieces after the lads' misbehaviour causes problems. A not-so-clever plan to earn some extra cash backfires, bringing the lads head to head with Sergeant Healy, who has been hot on their heels for some time and is determined to catch them up to no good.

programme.title: The Young Offenders
programme.desc: Comedy following the coming-of-age adventures of two best friends. Conor and Jock's friendships with the principal's daughters intensify, leading to a comic showdown.

programme.title: The Young Offenders
programme.desc: The lads persuade the girls to spend a full day with them on a beautiful adventure.

programme.title: The Young Offenders
programme.desc: Conor and his mam Mairead’s much loved fridge, bought by Conor’s dad, has finally given up on them. Remembering when the fridge was originally bought in town miles away, Mairead decides that a family bonding session on a road trip to that same town to buy a replacement fridge will be just the thing to bond with her son.

programme.title: The Young Offenders
programme.desc: Conor and Jock have been instructed to take up unpaid part-time work experience at Mairead's side on the fish stall in the English Market, bringing them up close and personal with life in the real world. With Jock's extra mouth to feed in the McSweeney household, money is getting more and more tight, leaving the trio to come up with inventive and unsatisfying ways of making food last longer. Determined to help out Mairead financially, the lads start to think about ways they can come up with some extra cash. The freak local catch of a very expensive fish gives the two lads an idea, leading them on a dubious adventure involving breaking and entering, a hilarious struggle and a memorable trip through Cork with their ill-gotten gains. Meanwhile, Mairead and Sergeant Healy are in two minds about taking their friendship to the next level, while Mairead tries to give Healy some driving lessons.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage as Mexico play their second game in Group A against South Korea in Guadalajara Stadium. This is Mexico’s ninth consecutive appearance and a record third overall as hosts or co-hosts; they reached the quarter-finals on each of the previous two occasions, in 1970 and 1986. Mexico hold the record, at 60, for the most World Cup matches without ever winning the trophy. South Korea are the only Asian team to reach the semi-finals, as co-hosts in 2002. This is their 11th consecutive World Cup and 12th overall, the most of any Asian nation. They are due to be captained by former Tottenham forward Son Heung-Min.

programme.title: Richard Osman's House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Ben Bailey Smith, Robin Ince, Lara Ricote and Helen Skelton take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, quiz legend Richard Osman. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games wheelie luggage, or will they be tempted with the very popular bee hotel?

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo concludes his epic rail journey across southern Norway, the Jutland Peninsula and the Danish archipelago. He crosses one of Europe’s epic rail engineering projects: the Great Belt Bridge, an 18-kilometre transport link stretching between the islands of Funen and Zealand, composed of a box girder bridge, a tunnel and a suspension bridge. At the bottom of Roskilde Fjord, he alights in the city of Roskilde, once a Viking trading hub. Five 1,000-year-old Viking vessels are preserved here, and to study their construction, seaworthy replicas are built. Michael is excited to set sail in one. In Copenhagen, Michael chills out in Europe’s cosiest capital in pursuit of the Danish concept of 'hygge'. What does it mean? Michael consults the experts. His next stop is Allerod, where Danish furniture design broke through in the mid-20th century. Icons such as the Papa Bear chair and the Round Chair are still made here. Finally, on the north eastern tip of Zealand, Michael reaches the magnificent 16th-century Kronborg Castle, the setting for Shakespeare’s Hamlet.

In Copenhagen, Michael chills out in Europe’s cosiest capital in pursuit of the Danish concept of 'hygge'. What does it mean? Michael consults the experts. His next stop is Allerod, where Danish furniture design broke through in the mid-20th century. Icons such as the Papa Bear chair and the Round Chair are still made here. Finally, on the north eastern tip of Zealand, Michael reaches the magnificent 16th-century Kronborg Castle, the setting for Shakespeare’s Hamlet.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: A special programme from Birmingham in the heart of Gardeners’ World Live – an annual vibrant celebration of practical gardening and bold design. Monty Don is joined by Frances Tophill, Adam Frost, Arit Anderson and Sue Kent for an hour packed with ideas, inspiration and expert advice. The team explore standout gardens, meet the people shaping the future of horticulture and reveal practical takeaways viewers can try at home. Sustainability is in the spotlight as pioneering growers reveal why cork could be a game-changing material – and how it’s already transforming the way they garden. There’s a surprising and ambitious show garden co-designed by Professor Alice Roberts, bringing the story of evolution to life through plants, and a first-time designer whose passion for railways has inspired a unique garden guaranteed to turn heads.

programme.title: Hidden Treasures of the National Trust
programme.desc: Hidden behind two famous gardens lie the legacies of two extraordinary designers: garden designer Gertrude Jekyll at Munstead Wood, one of the National Trust's newest properties, and flamboyant set designer Oliver Messel at Nymans, which overlooks the Sussex Weald. Together, they feature secret laboratories and historic seedlings, topiary cats and exquisite portraits.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage as Mexico play their second game in Group A against South Korea in Guadalajara Stadium. This is Mexico’s ninth consecutive appearance and a record third overall as hosts or co-hosts; they reached the quarter-finals on each of the previous two occasions, in 1970 and 1986. Mexico hold the record, at 60, for the most World Cup matches without ever winning the trophy. South Korea are the only Asian team to reach the semi-finals, as co-hosts in 2002. This is their 11th consecutive World Cup and 12th overall, the most of any Asian nation. They are due to be captained by former Tottenham forward Son Heung-Min.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: It's party time! The Teletubbies have balloons, party blowers and lots of sparkles. They visit the Tiddlytubbies and do a fun party dance. In Tummy Tales, twins celebrate their birthday with all their friends.

programme.title: Tee and Mo

programme.title: Supertato

Supertato uses some baking know-how to knead the dough back, but this makes it even bigger. Just as it is about to take over, Carrot uses the Evil Peamobile's ice blaster to freeze the dough and stop it in its tracks.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Sula and Bing are camping in Bing's garden in order to see the stars and the moon. As Flop goes back for Hoppity, night-time noises seep from the dark garden, spooking Bing. Then, a scary shape on the tent terrifies him. They go inside, but the monster has followed them in! Bing and Sula discover that Flop is the monster. So they go back outside, where the billion, zillion stars and a huge moon are waiting for them.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Farmer Jackson was just trying to grow some giant tomatoes, but he wound up with a giant pig! Now, Mojo and Bo have to get Felix back to normal size before Swoppiton gets stomped.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Join Duggee, a big, lovable dog, as he runs the Squirrel Club, where children can earn badges for learning new skills. Warm-hearted preschool series about trying new things.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels have played with all their toys, and they are frustrated because they feel they have nothing left to do. Duggee tells them that there’s always limitless fun if you use your imagination. He explains that you can use your mind to pretend to do or be anything you want and demonstrates how he can imagine he’s a dancer or even a horse. The Squirrels take turns thinking of what they want to be or what they want to do. At first, not everyone gets the hang of it, but soon enough, they all embark on their greatest adventure yet, in the new world they have imagined. Together, they can speed through space or float through an underwater world, where Norrie is a rock star and Tag can be king. All that immersive fun can happen just from the clubhouse!

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: Nugget attempts to make all her Piri friends’ secret ‘wishing tree’ hopes and dreams come true - but gets them the wrong way round, with funny and very unexpected consequences.

programme.title: Playtime Towers
programme.desc: Bella and Lift play a fun game in Playtime Towers, but who can find the musical instrument that makes a shaky drum sound? It’s a tambourine!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing and Flop play hide-and-seek on the way to Padget's shop. Bing doesn't want the game to end, and he hides behind the door to the stock room, where Flop really can't see him. When the door slams, Bing is stuck inside.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say ‘toothbrush’, and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see a red toothbrush, a blue toothbrush, a new toothbrush, a fuzzy toothbrush and even a giant toothbrush! Dee and a friend have fun brushing their teeth, and there’s even a toothbrush in a rush! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way, and everyone has a boogie when Dee’s friend finally succeeds in saying today’s word.

programme.title: Lu & the Bally Bunch
programme.desc: Lu decides she is going to France with Elodie and gets packing.

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: When Small is feeling strangely unsatisfied, her grandparents suggest she paints more regularly.

programme.title: Froglets
programme.desc: After finding some pasta, the Froglets create a rock band with maracas, a drum and a saxophone.

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: Stop-motion preschool series. The Twirlywoos learn how to fit pipes together when they create a surprising water feature, and the Very Important Lady falls apart.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Educational series using Makaton sign language. Justin and his friends go for a haircut today, while Mr Tumble has lots of messy fun pretending to be a hairdresser.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: A cloud appears in Teletubbyland and it begins to rain. Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po watch the flowers bloom. Another cloud appears and it rains pink tubby custard!

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Giovanna and Baby Bear welcome babies Alara, Samaa, Reece, Eleanor, Ty’lana and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Parents, carers and their little ones at home are invited to join in with all the fun activities too! Inside Giovanna’s bag is are some scented lavender bags, and all the parents and babies have different objects and toys that are smelly. These are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding safe, baby-appropriate smelly objects and toys inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The children’s nursery rhyme Ring A Ring O' Roses features, as does a story involving Baby Bear, and viewers at home show how they’ve been exploring smelly things too. The Action Song gets everyone moving about before some calm time with sensory lights and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: In Tall Trees Forest, Lisa and the children have bubbly fun washing toy clothes, learning British Sign Language signs for jungle, clothes and washing, then they sing and sign Down in the Jungle.

programme.title: What’s in Your Plant Pot?
programme.desc: Gardening expert Sue introduces the Fact Pack to roses. They discover that there are hundreds of types, why roses can smell lovely, and how their smell and flavour is in many different things.

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: Bean the warthog looks for a new den with the help of his friends, Hamza discovers some very loud Egyptian geese and helps make milk bottles for the hungry animals.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Bananaraptors fall into a hole, and Ginger and Pea-Rexes find a clever way to rescue them.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey, Bingo and Mum get into a debate with Dad about the definition of teasing. Dad argues that he was only playing as they recall all the times when he's been a big teaser.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Join Duggee, a big, lovable dog, as he runs the Squirrel Club, where children can earn badges for learning new skills. Warm-hearted preschool series about trying new things.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: Energetic Orange arrives in Colourland. Learn about the colour orange.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: Xiangfeng wants to know all about amazing ants! Ferne visits a leaf cutter ant colony at the zoo, while Rory and his son Sandy head into the forest, looking for wood ants. Also, we find out how ants play an important role in the growing of plants and crops. They are amazing soil engineers!

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Kyra and Khloe play at being a fairytale queen and princess, but when Khloe eats a pretend magic apple, she falls into a deep sleep. Will the Queen rescue her? Later, they enjoy a walk in the park with Mum, and there is more pretend play, with leaf monsters and crocodiles! Back at home, Kyra and Khloe become chefs and help Mum make a special dinner for the whole family.

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Connor lives in Scotland. He makes a delicious vegetarian haggis, to share with his friends. He serves his tasty haggis with freshly mashed neeps and tatties. As an extra special surprise, Connor has arranged for a special guest to play the Scottish bagpipes as the haggis is served, and his friends have no idea about this special surprise! They are all looking forward to trying the food, but they were not very keen on fresh coriander, which is one of the ingredients. Connor hopes to change their minds when they taste his vegetarian haggis.

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: In this episode, it is washing day! First, Maddie visits a washing machine repair centre to find out how washing machines work. She discovers how water gets into the drum through tiny holes and how a belt at the back spins the drum around very fast. Maddie puts her special camera inside the drum, and we see how the water and detergent are swished around to get a T-shirt clean inside. Next, Maddie goes to a jeans workshop and uses her special microscopic camera to discover how the weave in denim material makes it extremely strong. We also learn how lots of different shapes of materials are cut out and stitched together to make a pair of jeans.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Hearing dog Diesel is on an important mission - to wake his teenage owner Rayane, who's deaf, up in time for his football trial. There’s a big match tomorrow, and Rayane really wants to be picked for the team. It’s the summer holidays, so Rayane and Diesel have been sleeping in. Diesel needs to be on high alert! Diesel’s superears are trained to alert Rayane to important sounds he might miss. Diesel is Rayane’s ears! In the morning, Diesel must filter out all the noises in the house and listen for Dad calling Rayane for breakfast. Rayane is being picked up for the football match by his friend Karim, so Diesel has to listen out for the knock at the door. Will his superhearing help him filter out all the other sounds and make sure that Rayane gets to his football trial on time?

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet some European bison, including a large male called Loki. These bison are ten feet long and can weigh one tonne. They are the largest herbivores - or plant eaters - in Europe. Next, they meet two smaller but equally amazing animals - red-billed hornbills. This cheeky pair are the real-life versions of Zazu from the Lion King. With the hornbills perching nearby, Aneeshwar and Lizzie get to see these beautiful birds up close. Bison and hornbills are very different, but Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the unusual and extraordinary wild connection is between these two incredible animals.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Baba helps rescue a baby seagull when he gets trapped in fishing twine.

programme.title: Small Potatoes
programme.desc: Animated series about a group of singing potatoes. In this swinging homage to the Sinatra era, the Small Potatoes sing about how they are no average spuds.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Yukee is struggling with a tune on her ukulele, so she tells her friends she’s going to give it up. When Twinkle agrees that Yukee should try a new instrument, Yukee realises that sometimes a struggle comes before success.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Dad is taking Maddie to school on his bicycle, but their journey through the park soon turns into an intergalactic space adventure. They listen to the sounds around them and imagine themselves as brave explorers, shooting like rockets into the unknown.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are confused when they see Duggee sitting on a ball because they like to use it differently. Duggee is quick to explain to the Squirrels that there is no right or wrong way to play and that everyone is different. They go on a journey with the ball, watching it bounce, roll and slide from ear to paw as it rebounds between animals. The ball gets hit with a racket, flies through the sky, falls from a cliff and floats in the sea.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Coming now to a screen near you - the monster tale of a colossal creature who really, really likes bigger numbers. Learn about comparing numbers with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. K can kick but C can't - so it's word-magic-for-goalposts and a kid keeping score. Then they team up for CK vs the Sock - and they just need that magic touch. This episode introduces the letters C, K and the pair CK - and the words cot, kit, kid, can, cat, sock, sack and kick.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Maddie visits Effie to help her get Teddy ready for bed. Mr Tumble is feeling sleepy too, and he tries to take a nap. There's a bedtime story in the spotty surprise. Featuring signs for the words teddy bear, pyjamas and good night.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: It's Teletubby Circus time! Tinky Winky balances on the tight rope, Dipsy juggles, Laa-Laa flies on the trapeze and Po is a funny clown.

programme.title: Andy's Dinosaur Adventures
programme.desc: Andy travels back 127 million years to the time of ornithocheirus - one of the largest flying pterosaurs that ever lived. His mission is to find the skeleton of a sand dollar - a sea creature which spent its life crawling around on the ocean floor. Along the way he comes nose to beak with a tapejaras, a pterosaur which had a beautiful red crest, before taking to the skies on the back of an ornithocheirus. But will Andy succeed in time before the museum opens?

programme.title: Molly and Mack
programme.desc: Molly examines her shelf of special things at the back of Mack’s Stall. She chooses the guitar plectrum and remembers the day she got it. When Mack sees a guitar on the music stall that looks just like his mum’s old guitar, he can’t resist trying it out. Meanwhile, Moira is trying to think of something fun for her and Caitlin to do at the weekend, but everything she comes up with is boring, according to Caitlin. When Moira finds a pair of misplaced roller boots, she remembers how much she loved rollerskating when she was younger and decides to give it another go. Later, Alice tells James that she heard Mack playing the guitar, and it gets James thinking. Soon, Moira is having fun whizzing around the Big Hub, but she’s not quite as skilled on her skates as she remembers! As Moira decides she needs a little more practice, James gives Mack a gift – his mum’s old guitar.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: CBeebies’ very own motorcycle rider, Grace, shows off three amazing machines all built to rescue things! First, she rescues a stranded lorry in a heavy recovery vehicle. She then shows off an amazing firefighting super tanker and goes up the ladder of a fire truck.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: George and Freddie take part in a very special game of tennis. Game, set and match!

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: Paani and Min use the new Octoblimp to map a 'river in the sky'.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Benjamin falls into Mr Tod's clutches, Peter and Lily lure the fox out of his lair with the promise that he will be crowned King of the Woods!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Norrie admits that she can’t ride her new bike because she finds it too difficult. So Duggee gives her some encouragement and lets her know that there are skills that he is still yet to master too, like skateboarding. In fact, each Squirrel has a skill they find difficult. Tag can’t tie his shoe laces, Happy can’t click his fingers, Roly can’t swing and Betty discovers she can’t blink. Now that she is not alone, Norrie agrees to keep trying as Duggee encourages the Squirrels not to quit when things are difficult and that if at first you don’t succeed, try again! Duggee lets them know that when things are hard, you can always ask for help.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Juno has an accident when she doesn’t go to the toilet before playing hide-and-seek.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: The Veggies are delighted with a new tablet they’ve found. When they’re not looking, Evil Pea turns the tablet to evil mode. Soon the tablet takes over the supermarket.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: The Ducklings are fed up with Weasy's immaturity, so they use a device to make him more sensible. But when Weasy becomes super serious, the Ducklings want their real dad back.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Betty’s new ice cream flavour is so light, it makes everybody in town float in the air. How will Mojo and Bo get everyone’s feet back on the ground? By floating up there with them!

programme.title: Football Fantastics
programme.desc: Sophie must infiltrate the sports hall without disturbing a relaxation class Val is running. Her aim is to retrieve bibs, goals and a big bag of footballs.

programme.title: Hey Duggee

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: At the playground, Khia won’t let Rafi and Ruby have a turn on the zip line. Rafi makes a wish for a magical new zip line that loops through the clouds and zooms around the park. At first, it’s amazing. But Rafi and Ruby ride again and again, forgetting the rule of one turn each. Soon, a long queue forms, and the friends realise they’re doing exactly what Khia did. Rafi decides it’s time to let others have a go. She realises that playground fun works best when everyone gets a turn.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran are having a spring clear out, but when Gran Gran wants to clear out her old jumper, JoJo is distraught – she loves that snuggly jumper! Determined to keep it, JoJo hides the old jumper. But Gran Gran shows JoJo that a clear out doesn’t necessarily mean a throw out; with some creative thinking, they can give their old items new purposes.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Sarah decides that octagons are her favourite shape and starts an eight-person club to celebrate!

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: Tiny's radio hat has developed a fault, and she cannot hear her regular nightly lullaby sung for her by the Iron Chicken. She tries to find someone else amongst her friends who can sing to her, but in the end it is she herself who finds the solution by making up her own melody to sing to them.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo uses a GoGo Brick to help BaBa see a caterpillar. At Play Time, BaBa uses a GoGo Brick to place the last piece on top of a tower. At Yummy Time, MeMo and BaBa help the Yummies pick a tomato, and on the Lullaby Lake, Fungi and Pungi help MeMo and BaBa travel to the Bay of Books in the GoGo Boat, where Gramma Leeba is waiting for them.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: The Pontipines count to six. Upsy Daisy shows Igglepiggle how to jump. Soon everybody is joining in the jumping game, from the great big Haahoos to the teeny tiny Pontipines. Everybody joins in the dance at the gazebo.

programme.desc: Eilish McColgan reads a charming and funny story about courage, self-belief, and the quiet confidence of one determined tortoise.

programme.desc: Bluey, Bingo and Mum get into a debate with Dad about the definition of teasing. Dad argues that he was only playing as they recall all the times when he's been a big teaser.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Join Duggee, a big, lovable dog, as he runs the Squirrel Club, where children can earn badges for learning new skills. Warm-hearted preschool series about trying new things.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: Energetic Orange arrives in Colourland. Learn about the colour orange.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: Xiangfeng wants to know all about amazing ants! Ferne visits a leaf cutter ant colony at the zoo, while Rory and his son Sandy head into the forest, looking for wood ants. Also, we find out how ants play an important role in the growing of plants and crops. They are amazing soil engineers!

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Kyra and Khloe play at being a fairytale queen and princess, but when Khloe eats a pretend magic apple, she falls into a deep sleep. Will the Queen rescue her? Later, they enjoy a walk in the park with Mum, and there is more pretend play, with leaf monsters and crocodiles! Back at home, Kyra and Khloe become chefs and help Mum make a special dinner for the whole family.

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Connor lives in Scotland. He makes a delicious vegetarian haggis, to share with his friends. He serves his tasty haggis with freshly mashed neeps and tatties. As an extra special surprise, Connor has arranged for a special guest to play the Scottish bagpipes as the haggis is served, and his friends have no idea about this special surprise! They are all looking forward to trying the food, but they were not very keen on fresh coriander, which is one of the ingredients. Connor hopes to change their minds when they taste his vegetarian haggis.

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: In this episode, it is washing day! First, Maddie visits a washing machine repair centre to find out how washing machines work. She discovers how water gets into the drum through tiny holes and how a belt at the back spins the drum around very fast. Maddie puts her special camera inside the drum, and we see how the water and detergent are swished around to get a T-shirt clean inside. Next, Maddie goes to a jeans workshop and uses her special microscopic camera to discover how the weave in denim material makes it extremely strong. We also learn how lots of different shapes of materials are cut out and stitched together to make a pair of jeans.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Hearing dog Diesel is on an important mission - to wake his teenage owner Rayane, who's deaf, up in time for his football trial. There’s a big match tomorrow, and Rayane really wants to be picked for the team. It’s the summer holidays, so Rayane and Diesel have been sleeping in. Diesel needs to be on high alert! Diesel’s superears are trained to alert Rayane to important sounds he might miss. Diesel is Rayane’s ears! In the morning, Diesel must filter out all the noises in the house and listen for Dad calling Rayane for breakfast. Rayane is being picked up for the football match by his friend Karim, so Diesel has to listen out for the knock at the door. Will his superhearing help him filter out all the other sounds and make sure that Rayane gets to his football trial on time?

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet some European bison, including a large male called Loki. These bison are ten feet long and can weigh one tonne. They are the largest herbivores - or plant eaters - in Europe. Next, they meet two smaller but equally amazing animals - red-billed hornbills. This cheeky pair are the real-life versions of Zazu from the Lion King. With the hornbills perching nearby, Aneeshwar and Lizzie get to see these beautiful birds up close. Bison and hornbills are very different, but Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the unusual and extraordinary wild connection is between these two incredible animals.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Baba helps rescue a baby seagull when he gets trapped in fishing twine.

programme.title: Small Potatoes
programme.desc: Animated series about a group of singing potatoes. In this swinging homage to the Sinatra era, the Small Potatoes sing about how they are no average spuds.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Yukee is struggling with a tune on her ukulele, so she tells her friends she’s going to give it up. When Twinkle agrees that Yukee should try a new instrument, Yukee realises that sometimes a struggle comes before success.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Dad is taking Maddie to school on his bicycle, but their journey through the park soon turns into an intergalactic space adventure. They listen to the sounds around them and imagine themselves as brave explorers, shooting like rockets into the unknown.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are confused when they see Duggee sitting on a ball because they like to use it differently. Duggee is quick to explain to the Squirrels that there is no right or wrong way to play and that everyone is different. They go on a journey with the ball, watching it bounce, roll and slide from ear to paw as it rebounds between animals. The ball gets hit with a racket, flies through the sky, falls from a cliff and floats in the sea.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Coming now to a screen near you - the monster tale of a colossal creature who really, really likes bigger numbers. Learn about comparing numbers with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. K can kick but C can't - so it's word-magic-for-goalposts and a kid keeping score. Then they team up for CK vs the Sock - and they just need that magic touch. This episode introduces the letters C, K and the pair CK - and the words cot, kit, kid, can, cat, sock, sack and kick.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Maddie visits Effie to help her get Teddy ready for bed. Mr Tumble is feeling sleepy too, and he tries to take a nap. There's a bedtime story in the spotty surprise. Featuring signs for the words teddy bear, pyjamas and good night.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: It's Teletubby Circus time! Tinky Winky balances on the tight rope, Dipsy juggles, Laa-Laa flies on the trapeze and Po is a funny clown.

programme.title: Andy's Dinosaur Adventures
programme.desc: Andy travels back 127 million years to the time of ornithocheirus - one of the largest flying pterosaurs that ever lived. His mission is to find the skeleton of a sand dollar - a sea creature which spent its life crawling around on the ocean floor. Along the way he comes nose to beak with a tapejaras, a pterosaur which had a beautiful red crest, before taking to the skies on the back of an ornithocheirus. But will Andy succeed in time before the museum opens?

programme.title: Molly and Mack
programme.desc: Molly examines her shelf of special things at the back of Mack’s Stall. She chooses the guitar plectrum and remembers the day she got it. When Mack sees a guitar on the music stall that looks just like his mum’s old guitar, he can’t resist trying it out. Meanwhile, Moira is trying to think of something fun for her and Caitlin to do at the weekend, but everything she comes up with is boring, according to Caitlin. When Moira finds a pair of misplaced roller boots, she remembers how much she loved rollerskating when she was younger and decides to give it another go. Later, Alice tells James that she heard Mack playing the guitar, and it gets James thinking. Soon, Moira is having fun whizzing around the Big Hub, but she’s not quite as skilled on her skates as she remembers! As Moira decides she needs a little more practice, James gives Mack a gift – his mum’s old guitar.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: CBeebies’ very own motorcycle rider, Grace, shows off three amazing machines all built to rescue things! First, she rescues a stranded lorry in a heavy recovery vehicle. She then shows off an amazing firefighting super tanker and goes up the ladder of a fire truck.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Norrie admits that she can’t ride her new bike because she finds it too difficult. So Duggee gives her some encouragement and lets her know that there are skills that he is still yet to master too, like skateboarding. In fact, each Squirrel has a skill they find difficult. Tag can’t tie his shoe laces, Happy can’t click his fingers, Roly can’t swing and Betty discovers she can’t blink. Now that she is not alone, Norrie agrees to keep trying as Duggee encourages the Squirrels not to quit when things are difficult and that if at first you don’t succeed, try again! Duggee lets them know that when things are hard, you can always ask for help.

programme.title: The Essex Millionaire Murders
programme.desc: The first part of a two-part documentary series. Easter Sunday, 2023 - a wealthy couple in their 60s are found dead by their daughter on Mersea Island in Essex. Carol and Stephen Baxter are in their armchairs with no sign of a struggle as police rule out carbon monoxide poisoning - when Senior Investigating Officer Lydia George and her team discover a mysterious will that leaves everything to the Baxters' daughter Ellena and their family friend Luke D'Wit, the detectives find out that D'Wit was helping Carol as a carer as her health slowly deteriorated. Carol was closely following the advice of a mysterious American doctor promising to cure her thyroid condition - as a postmortem reveals that the couple had lethal levels of antihistamine and fentanyl in their systems, Ellena and Luke are arrested on suspicion of murder as detectives search for answers.

programme.title: TikTok: Murder Gone Viral
programme.desc: With exclusive access to the victims' families, friends and the police, this documentary strand explores extraordinary true crime cases linked to the world's fastest-growing social media platform. In the early hours of the 11th of February 2022, two 21-year-old men - Saqib Hussain and Hashim Ijazuddin - were found dead in a burning car on the A46 in Leicestershire. Within a short time, police arrested two unlikely culprits: 22-year-old TikTok influencer Mahek Bukhari and her 45-year-old mother Ansreen. Mahek from Stoke-on-Trent has over 160,000 followers on TikTok and many millions of views - her mum Ansreen regularly appeared in her videos. Detectives discovered that Ansreen had been in a three-year-long secret relationship with Saqib Hussain which began when he was just 18 - when she wanted to end the relationship in January 2022 and Saqib threatened to send nude photos and sex tapes to her husband, Mahek hatched a plan to silence him and enlisted others into her scheme.

Go behind the lens to hear firsthand accounts of these once-in-a-lifetime experiences, starting in Arizona where two first responders happened to be in the right place at the right time to rescue a woman trapped in an inferno. In the mountains of East Asia, one intrepid traveller captures a once-in-a-lifetime experience on camera, while in Yorkshire, a commuter has a very close brush with death. Heading down under, we meet lifelong friends and fishermen who nearly became bait after their boat sank, and back in the UK, one toddler comes to her dad's rescue in the most remarkable way. Finally, we meet a family whose US road trip was crashed by a furry friend. All stories you wouldn't believe if they weren't caught on camera.

programme.title: The Essex Millionaire Murders
programme.desc: The first part of a two-part documentary series. Easter Sunday, 2023 - a wealthy couple in their 60s are found dead by their daughter on Mersea Island in Essex. Carol and Stephen Baxter are in their armchairs with no sign of a struggle as police rule out carbon monoxide poisoning - when Senior Investigating Officer Lydia George and her team discover a mysterious will that leaves everything to the Baxters' daughter Ellena and their family friend Luke D'Wit, the detectives find out that D'Wit was helping Carol as a carer as her health slowly deteriorated. Carol was closely following the advice of a mysterious American doctor promising to cure her thyroid condition - as a postmortem reveals that the couple had lethal levels of antihistamine and fentanyl in their systems, Ellena and Luke are arrested on suspicion of murder as detectives search for answers.

programme.title: TikTok: Murder Gone Viral
programme.desc: With exclusive access to the victims' families, friends and the police, this documentary strand explores extraordinary true crime cases linked to the world's fastest-growing social media platform. In the early hours of the 11th of February 2022, two 21-year-old men - Saqib Hussain and Hashim Ijazuddin - were found dead in a burning car on the A46 in Leicestershire. Within a short time, police arrested two unlikely culprits: 22-year-old TikTok influencer Mahek Bukhari and her 45-year-old mother Ansreen. Mahek from Stoke-on-Trent has over 160,000 followers on TikTok and many millions of views - her mum Ansreen regularly appeared in her videos. Detectives discovered that Ansreen had been in a three-year-long secret relationship with Saqib Hussain which began when he was just 18 - when she wanted to end the relationship in January 2022 and Saqib threatened to send nude photos and sex tapes to her husband, Mahek hatched a plan to silence him and enlisted others into her scheme.

programme.desc: Unbelievable, shocking and uplifting viral videos filmed all over the world and narrated by award-winning actor Roger Allam. programme.title: The Essex Millionaire Murders
programme.desc: The first part of a two-part documentary series. Easter Sunday, 2023 - a wealthy couple in their 60s are found dead by their daughter on Mersea Island in Essex. Carol and Stephen Baxter are in their armchairs with no sign of a struggle as police rule out carbon monoxide poisoning - when Senior Investigating Officer Lydia George and her team discover a mysterious will that leaves everything to the Baxters' daughter Ellena and their family friend Luke D'Wit, the detectives find out that D'Wit was helping Carol as a carer as her health slowly deteriorated. Carol was closely following the advice of a mysterious American doctor promising to cure her thyroid condition - as a postmortem reveals that the couple had lethal levels of antihistamine and fentanyl in their systems, Ellena and Luke are arrested on suspicion of murder as detectives search for answers.

programme.title: TikTok: Murder Gone Viral
programme.desc: With exclusive access to the victims' families, friends and the police, this documentary strand explores extraordinary true crime cases linked to the world's fastest-growing social media platform. In the early hours of the 11th of February 2022, two 21-year-old men - Saqib Hussain and Hashim Ijazuddin - were found dead in a burning car on the A46 in Leicestershire. Within a short time, police arrested two unlikely culprits: 22-year-old TikTok influencer Mahek Bukhari and her 45-year-old mother Ansreen. Mahek from Stoke-on-Trent has over 160,000 followers on TikTok and many millions of views - her mum Ansreen regularly appeared in her videos. Detectives discovered that Ansreen had been in a three-year-long secret relationship with Saqib Hussain which began when he was just 18 - when she wanted to end the relationship in January 2022 and Saqib threatened to send nude photos and sex tapes to her husband, Mahek hatched a plan to silence him and enlisted others into her scheme.

programme.title: Law & Order: UK
programme.desc: Brooks and Devlin are baffled by the seemingly motiveless murder of student Archie Rahman. With little evidence to work with, the detectives find themselves at a dead end until they come across a library book that the deceased had checked out on the day of his death. Their investigation reveals that two other students also have a connection to the book. When each suspect gives the other an alibi, the detectives know that one of them is lying - but which one? After senior prosecutors Alesha Phillips and James Steel are charged with bringing the case to court, one of the perpetrators finally confesses, but claims that he acted in self defence. Steel finds that he must tread carefully and prove the case convincingly to avoid setting the guilty party free and smearing Rahman's reputation. Meanwhile, Alesha attempts to confront the demons in her past that have been thrown up by the case.

programme.title: Law & Order: UK
programme.desc: Stephanie Blake has been stalked for two years by a man who calls himself 'Giovanni' and who seems to know every intimate detail of her life. Over time, Giovanni's emails and calls have become more intimidating, but without an actual physical threat against her, the police can do little for Stephanie. After initial investigations go nowhere, the officers are forced to abandon the case. But then something happens which shakes the police to their very core. In the courtroom, senior Crown prosecutor James Steel faces off against defence barrister Evelyn Wyndham, but what should be a straightforward prosecution turns complicated after a major piece of evidence is excluded. Then one of the investigating officers becomes a key witness for the prosecution, raising the question of whether he is motivated by guilt. Will he perjure himself in order to get the right result?

programme.title: The Essex Millionaire Murders
programme.desc: The first part of a two-part documentary series. Easter Sunday, 2023 - a wealthy couple in their 60s are found dead by their daughter on Mersea Island in Essex. Carol and Stephen Baxter are in their armchairs with no sign of a struggle as police rule out carbon monoxide poisoning - when Senior Investigating Officer Lydia George and her team discover a mysterious will that leaves everything to the Baxters' daughter Ellena and their family friend Luke D'Wit, the detectives find out that D'Wit was helping Carol as a carer as her health slowly deteriorated. Carol was closely following the advice of a mysterious American doctor promising to cure her thyroid condition - as a postmortem reveals that the couple had lethal levels of antihistamine and fentanyl in their systems, Ellena and Luke are arrested on suspicion of murder as detectives search for answers.

programme.title: TikTok: Murder Gone Viral
programme.desc: With exclusive access to the victims' families, friends and the police, this documentary strand explores extraordinary true crime cases linked to the world's fastest-growing social media platform. In the early hours of the 11th of February 2022, two 21-year-old men - Saqib Hussain and Hashim Ijazuddin - were found dead in a burning car on the A46 in Leicestershire. Within a short time, police arrested two unlikely culprits: 22-year-old TikTok influencer Mahek Bukhari and her 45-year-old mother Ansreen. Mahek from Stoke-on-Trent has over 160,000 followers on TikTok and many millions of views - her mum Ansreen regularly appeared in her videos. Detectives discovered that Ansreen had been in a three-year-long secret relationship with Saqib Hussain which began when he was just 18 - when she wanted to end the relationship in January 2022 and Saqib threatened to send nude photos and sex tapes to her husband, Mahek hatched a plan to silence him and enlisted others into her scheme.
